**This repository is a published snapshot**, so this PR cannot be merged here —
the next publish would overwrite it. A maintainer will port your change into the
private source repository, credit you in the commit, and close this PR with a
link to the live page. Nothing is lost; it just takes one extra step on our end.

If you would rather not have a PR sitting open in the meantime, feel free to
close it and [open an issue](../../issues/new/choose) instead — the change gets
made either way.
